description: Decode a raw Bitcoin transaction (hex): txid, wtxid, size, vsize, weight, inputs, outputs with addresses and values, SegWit and RBF flags. Nothing is broadcast. Paid per call. Price: 3 sats or US$0.003 (USDC) per call.

l402.description: Optional. After paying the Lightning invoice: '<token>:<preimage>'.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' returns a BOLT11 invoice and a token instead of the x402 payment request.

name: bitcoin_decode_transaction
title: Decode a Bitcoin transaction
